messages.text: We are a hackathon team building a webapp for hackathon teams.  First idea: Deconstruct your prompt to understand it, and Claude’s understanding and assumptions.

I mapped a full-stack plan for a prompt deconstruction webapp: Claude breaks your prompt into its understanding and assumptions. I assumed a dark hacker style, a desktop-first canvas, Claude API analysis, Postgres storage and Vercel hosting, so please check those. The most important open question is whether the refined output should feed straight into code generation or stay an analysis tool.
